definition: Ethan Mollick is a Wharton associate professor, artificial intelligence (AI) researcher, and the author of New York Times bestseller Co-Intelligence.
details: Research and writing on AI in work and education. His work focuses primarily on the impact of AI on work and education, and he was named one of TIME Magazine's Most Influential People in Artificial Intelligence of 2024.

explainer.lead: Ethan Mollick is an American AI and education researcher. His work spans entrepreneurship, innovation, management and artificial intelligence.

contributions.name: After completing his graduate studies, Mollick co‑founded eMeta Corporation, a technology startup where he served as vice president of business development.

timeline.what: Master of Science, MIT Sloan School of Management
Doctor of Philosophy, MIT Sloan School of Management
